Terms and Conditions

By using any course, content, or digital platform of Rifat Academy, you agree to the following terms and policies.

1. Account & User Policy

  • Your account (username and password) is strictly personal. Sharing your account with others may result in suspension or termination.

  • Each course is intended only for the registered user. Family members or friends cannot use your account.

  • You can log in to the platform from one device at a time. Multiple simultaneous logins may restrict access.

  • Registration information (name, email, phone number) must be accurate. Certificates and records will reflect the provided information.

  • Providing false or misleading information may result in temporary or permanent suspension of your account.

2. Content & Copyright

  • All course materials, including videos, audios, documents, and written content, are the property of Rifat Academy.

  • Copying, sharing, distributing, or uploading content without prior permission is strictly prohibited and may result in legal action.

  • Some content may include personalized watermarks. Content is intended solely for personal learning. Ownership of the materials remains with Rifat Academy.

3. Payment & Course Access

  • Payments must be made only through the official website or authorized payment gateways. Rifat Academy is not responsible for payments made through unofficial channels.

  • Access to the course is granted immediately after successful payment.

  • Prices, promotions, and discounts are subject to change without prior notice.

4. Support & Community Guidelines

  • Course-related issues are typically resolved within 24–48 hours via our support channels.

  • Support is available daily from 9 AM to 8 PM.

  • Users must maintain respectful, polite, and constructive behavior in any Rifat Academy community, chat, or group. Offensive language, political discussions, or spam may result in account suspension.

5. Refunds, Cancellations & Updates

  • Purchased courses cannot be exchanged or refunded unless explicitly stated.

  • Suspicious activity, unauthorized sharing, or multiple device misuse may limit access to courses.

  • Rifat Academy reserves the right to update or modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform implies acceptance of the latest terms.

6. Disclaimer

  • Rifat Academy provides educational content for learning purposes only. Course completion or participation does not guarantee any specific exam results or career outcomes.

  • Students are responsible for using the content ethically and in compliance with applicable laws.
